name: Potion of Heroism
description: A blue liquid that bubbles as if it were boiling, though it is cold.
body:
## What it does

Drink it and you gain 10 temporary hit points, and for an hour you are blessed, as the bless spell does, without having to concentrate on it.

features.name: Heroism
features.text: For an hour after drinking you are under the bless spell, without concentration.
